darwin.errorExcerpt:
handshake failed: MCP error -32000: Connection closed
--- stderr (tail) ---
Installed 1 package in 1ms
agentfenster-mcp: the agentfenster app is not installed on this machine.

This package is only the launcher. The MCP server itself ships with the
agentfenster app - a commercial, closed-source program for Windows 10 and 11.

  1. Install the app:
       https://agentfenster.com
     Every plan starts with a 3-day trial. No card, no account.

  2. Register the server with Claude Code:
       claude mcp add agentfenster -- agentfenster-mcp

     Any MCP client that can launch a local stdio server works the same way.

Documentation: https://agentfenster.com/mcp
Discord:       https://discord.gg/J9MfKP255Y
